text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 94:99 (approximately 0.949:1), target canvas 1222 × 1287 pixels.

Create a tall 2 by 2 character fashion board, each section contains exactly three complete full-body outfits of one person. Top-left Yuna, top-right Theo, bottom-left Mara, bottom-right June. Yuna, a 17-year-old girl with fair warm skin, a short honey-blonde side-parted bob with tousled waves, gray-green eyes, a softly angular jaw, straight small nose and natural pink lips; composed and observant.
Theo, a 17-year-old slim boy with fair freckled skin, dense short copper-auburn curls, green-brown eyes, a narrow youthful face, straight slender nose and a lightly playful closed-mouth expression; clean-shaven.
Mara, an 18-year-old girl with warm light olive-beige skin, scattered freckles across cheeks and nose, hazel-green almond eyes, thick dark softly arched brows, distinct cheekbones, full natural lips, a softly oval-square jaw, and long voluminous ash-brown waves parted in the center. Her hair has fine warm highlights, her face is youthful and she has no glasses.
June, a 38-year-old woman with warm fair skin, hazel eyes, a softly oval face with fine adult expression lines, chestnut-brown hair in a loose updo with face-framing strands, natural lips, warm steady gaze and small earrings.
Yuna: burgundy blazer, white shirt, dark knit vest, plaid short skirt, white socks and dark loafers; ivory/navy track jacket with loose dark track trousers; black sleeveless top with wide gray trousers. Theo: dark vest over gray hoodie with cream cargos; olive technical jacket over gray top with charcoal cargos; navy number 23 sports jersey over white long sleeves with baggy dark jeans. Mara: faded brick-red raincoat with blue straight jeans; hooded red raincoat with dark cargo pants; charcoal cardigan, dark denim long skirt and black boots. June: cream knit with pale-gray apron, loose light jeans and gray sneakers; dark utility jacket with light jeans and white tee; olive utility jacket, cream tee, light jeans and brown crossbody bag.
Keep identities distinct and constant within each section. Theo 8.2–8.5 heads tall; Yuna and Mara 7.8; June 7.5, adult face. Full feet and crowns visible, natural relaxed poses, simple names above each section, ivory studio background. Photorealistic live-action character photography, bright high-key cream-white exposure, soft frontal window daylight with generous fill, warm-neutral skin and pale ivory surroundings, low shadow density without flat or blown-out faces, subtle optical halation, realistic 50mm portrait perspective, fine individual hairs, faint freckles and visible natural pores. Youthful unretouched skin, restrained natural lips, no heavy makeup, oily gloss, plastic skin, HDR, dark teal-orange grading, anime or 3D rendering.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。
